name: Minase Kana
source: An avid eroge player just like [url=https://vndb.org/c45063]Hiroki[/url]. She realizes quite early on that Hiroki's intentions are to create a harem out of the members of the White Lily Society and that he doesn't view the relationship he has with the girls as practice. So she's very reluctant to have sex with Hiroki because doing so would acknowledge to herself that she's part of his harem.
